codex login status -c cli_auth_credentials_store="file", in a new empty CODEX_HOME, an allowlisted environment and one made-up variable (not a key) each time:
OPENAI_API_KEY alone: "Not logged in" (exit 1)
CODEX_API_KEY alone: "Not logged in" (exit 1)
CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN alone: "Error checking login status: invalid agent identity JWT format" (exit 1)
none of them: "Not logged in" (exit 1)
